title: MACHINES AND EFFECTS: HIS ART PICKS
why: His art survey picks: a27 B charging ring before a machine shot, a28 B small blast and chunks when a machine dies, a30 B moonlit blue night, a31 B lighter fog, a34 B chunkier sparks and blood, a35 B blast 60 percent bigger with a bigger scorch. Drawing only: the damage radius does not change and the ring never draws past it.
now: Machines charge a shrinking red ring, die in a small blast with chunks, nights are moonlit blue, fog is lighter, hit sparks are chunkier and explosions are 60 percent bigger.
